new.title: Publier un avis
new.intro: Les avis appartiennent à un sujet. Pour publier dans un sujet, vous devez posséder au moins un justificatif au niveau application ou supérieur pour une compétence de ce sujet.
new.noEligibleWarning: Vous n'avez pas encore de justificatif qualifiant. Obtenez un justificatif au niveau application ou supérieur pour n'importe quelle compétence, et vous pourrez publier des avis dans le sujet de cette compétence.
new.titlePlaceholder: ex. Pourquoi l'approche fonctionnelle d'abord est un mauvais choix par défaut pour l'informatique de première année
new.summaryPlaceholder: Une phrase de cadrage pour la vue en liste.

threads.heading: Opinions
threads.intro: Ideas worth discussing. Perspectives backed by experience.
threads.empty: No published threads in this topic yet. Explore the example viewpoints below.
threads.aboutBody: Share a perspective, ask a thoughtful question, or explore another point of view. Threads and interactions sync between connected Alexandria peers.
threads.gateBody: Posting and commenting both require a credential accepted by the topic’s qualification policy. Your node checks the author’s proof before accepting a contribution.
threads.voteNote: Votes reflect community opinion. They do not increase credential reputation. One vote per identity; identities are not verified unique people.
threads.videoLabel: Video · MP4 or WebM · up to 25 MB
threads.thumbnailLabel: Thumbnail (optional) · PNG, JPEG or WebP · up to 25 MB
threads.publishDisclosure: I agree to publish this post and its qualifying credential and endorsement evidence to peers. Uploaded media becomes publicly retrievable as soon as it is uploaded, even if I cancel this post.
threads.commentDisclosure: Publish this comment and its qualifying credential and endorsement evidence to peers.
threads.gated: To post or comment here, earn an Apply-level or higher credential accepted by this topic’s policy. Self-issued credentials alone do not qualify. You can still read and vote.
threads.noPolicy: This topic has no pinned qualification policy on this network yet. Reading and voting are available; posting and commenting are closed.
threads.deleteConfirm: Delete this contribution from the thread? A signed deletion will sync to peers. Replies remain, and copies already held by other people cannot be erased.
threads.reportDisclosure: This publishes a signed report and its reason to peers. Reports do not automatically remove content. Do not include private information.
threads.noComments: No comments yet. Start the conversation.
threads.notFound: This thread has not arrived on this device yet. Return to the feed and refresh after connecting to peers.
threads.proofBody: At receipt, a credential for this author satisfied the topic’s pinned qualification policy. This is a posting qualification, not an endorsement of the opinion.
